description: This file defines the GeoService class, which provides an optional reverse geocoding service based on environment configuration. It can perform reverse geocoding if enabled and properly configured, though currently implemented as a stub without external API integration.

classes.name: GeoService
classes.description: Provides reverse geocoding functionality, which is currently a stub implementation that can be enabled or disabled via environment variables.

methods.name: GeoService
methods.description: Constructor that initializes whether reverse geocoding is enabled and stores the API key, based on environment variables.

methods.name: reverseGeocode
methods.description: Attempts to perform reverse geocoding; returns a string with an approximate location if enabled and configured, otherwise null.
